dedupe_keys.name: global crop type validation data set for the esa worldcereal system street level imagery 2021

description: This dataset holds crop type observations made by experts viewing georeferenced street-level images such as Google Street View and Mapillary in IIASA's Street Imagery validation tool, for 2021. The Zenodo record says it includes a shapefile of collected polygons with crop type, a table of crop type and irrigation observations with image source, date and centroid coordinates in WGS84, and a subset used to validate WorldCereal 2021 crop type maps, and that it is independent of existing maps and reference data. It was published in April 2023 by researchers at IIASA and the National University of Life and Environmental Sciences of Ukraine under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as three files of about 3 MB. Coverage is global where street images exist. Caveats: not all polygons match field boundaries, sampling was opportunistic along roads, and only mature crops could be identified. For simulation it gives independent ground labels to validate crop maps used for agricultural exposure and loss estimates. Related catalogue records include the WorldCereal harmonized reference data and the GEOGLAM best available crop type masks.
name: Global crop type validation data set for the ESA WorldCereal system (street-level imagery, 2021)
provider: IIASA and National University of Life and Environmental Sciences of Ukraine authors (Lesiv, Bilous, Laso Bayas, Karanam, Fritz), via Zenodo
